## Changes
- Recording: start, stop or discard a recording from anywhere with keyboard shortcuts you choose in Settings → General → Shortcuts. - Recording: Start, Stop, Toggle and Cancel recording actions for the Shortcuts app, Raycast and Siri. - Recording: an optional floating pill shows the timer and the newest live caption, with Stop and Discard buttons. A discarded recording goes to the Trash. - Recording: optional start and stop sounds. - Recording: choose which microphone to record from, and a different one for when the MacBook lid is closed. If the chosen microphone is unplugged, Ahoy switches to the default one and keeps recording. - Live captions: Parakeet now shows live captions on this Mac, with no network, a few seconds behind speech. - Transcription: Parakeet and Whisper can tell the people on the other side of the call apart (Speaker 1, Speaker 2…) after a small one-time download in Settings → Transcription. - Transcription: optionally remove filler words (um, uh, ăă…) from final transcripts. - Transcription: optionally correct misheard custom-vocabulary words in Parakeet and Whisper transcripts. - Insights: use your own OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Groq…) or Apple Intelligence (macOS 26) for summaries and questions. - Insights: add your own instructions to every summary, such as "Write in Romanian". - Insights: Translate to English with one click in the call assistant. - Storage: keep call audio forever, delete it after transcription, or after 3 days, 2 weeks or 3 months. Transcripts and insights are always kept. Star a call to keep its audio. - Menu bar: Copy Last Transcript, a Transcription engine submenu, and Unload Local Models. - Settings: remove the Parakeet and Whisper models, see which languages each covers, choose how long on-device models stay in memory, and view the last hour of Ahoy's log. - Ahoy is available in Romanian when your Mac (or Ahoy's language in System Settings) is set to Romanian. - Updates now show what changed before you install.
